rationale: All 8.59 ns runs end ~1.4 ns positive, so setup repair never engages; T_eff reflects the AREA 3 netlist plus placement. Other strategies scored far worse; buffering/sizing, repair margins and post-GRT repair looked neutral. Floorplan moved results: at 57% density, util 42->48 improved 7.146->7.035 (smaller die, cells fill more of the core, less pull toward IO pins), while density off 57% hurt, more steeply above (52%: +0.07; 65-70%: +0.23-0.35). Final round: the best run's settings at max util 50. A keeps 57% density (dd 7); B uses 55% (dd 5), erring to the gentler low side for the fullest core. 0.4 ns margins keep the re-check robust.
